condition: In the browser, calling dayjs.utc(...).tz('utc').startOf('day') on January 1 and then .add(1,'month').startOf('month') gives a date one year too early (for example 2022-02-01).
workaround: Don't call .tz('utc') on a date that is already UTC; use dayjs.utc(...) by itself before startOf/add.
